records.title: Writing rules reach only project sessions
records.text: The user-facing writing rules ship in the AGENTS.md managed block, which every supported harness loads inside a Yoke project. A session outside any project gets no Yoke standing rules, so it does not receive them. Global orientation and yoke-global must carry the same rules from the same authority when they ship.
